nodes.description: FlokiFomo.transfer(address,uint) payable; forwards call to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
FlokiFomo.transferFrom(address,uint) payable; checks allowance, calls ensure(), and updates balanceOf/_onSaleNum without SafeMath.
FlokiFomo.approve(address,uint); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
FlokiFomo.ensure(address,uint) internal view; whitelist gate (owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress, canSale) otherwise requires condition().
FlokiFomo.condition(address,uint) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale limits.
FlokiFomo.delegate(address,bytes) payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address.
FlokiFomo.init(uint,uint,uint); owner-only sale parameter initialization.
FlokiFomo.batchSend(address[],uint) payable; owner-only loop that moves balances and emits duplicate Transfer events.
FlokiFomo.setTradeAddress(address); owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
FlokiFomo.pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure; computes Uniswap pair address via init code hash.
FlokiFomo constructor; mints supply to msg.sender, sets owner, grants max allowance to router.
address private owner; privileged account used by all access-control requires.
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-account sale counter, incremented in transferFrom.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist flag checked in ensure().
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount for non-whitelisted accounts.
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount for non-whitelisted accounts.
uint256 private _saleNum; max allowed number of sales per account.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted trading address, owner-settable.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply.
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; hardcoded router address whitelisted in ensure().
msg.sender; caller-controlled address used for allowances, ownership checks and balance updates.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) to a caller-supplied address inside delegate().
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed without SafeMath (arithmetic risk under 0.5.x).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend without SafeMath overflow protection.
Parameter _to of transfer(address,uint).
Parameter _value of transfer(address,uint).
Parameter _from of transferFrom(address,address,uint).
Parameter _value of transferFrom(address,address,uint); amount moved and checked against limits.
Parameter _spender of approve(address,uint).
Parameter _value of approve(address,uint).
Parameter a (target address) of delegate(address,bytes).
Parameter b (calldata) of delegate(address,bytes).
Parameter _tos (recipient array) of batchSend(address[],uint).
Parameter _value (per-recipient amount) of batchSend(address[],uint).
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress(address).
Parameter saleNum of init(uint,uint,uint).
Parameter token (min sale) of init(uint,uint,uint).
Parameter maxToken (max sale) of init(uint,uint,uint).

edges.reason: transfer() forwards immediately into transferFrom().
_to parameter of transfer is used as the recipient of the forwarded transferFrom call.
_value parameter of transfer flows into the forwarded transferFrom call.
msg.sender is used as _from and as the allowance owner inside transferFrom.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping written in approve().
delegate() is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner), the sole protection on an arbitrary delegatecall.
init() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner) and moves msg.sender balances.
setTradeAddress() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mint-balances to msg.sender.
_from parameter indexes balanceOf, allowance and _onSaleNum in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance mutations in transferFrom.
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping in approve().
_value parameter is stored as the approval amount.
User-supplied target address a is the delegatecall destination.
User-supplied bytes b becomes the delegatecall payload.
_tos array supplies loop recipients in batchSend.
_value parameter is the per-recipient amount in batchSend.
addr parameter is written into tradeAddress.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter is scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled into _maxSale.
balanceOf is read and written (unprotected arithmetic) inside transferFrom.
allowance is checked and decremented inside transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom.
batchSend reads and deducts balanceOf[msg.sender] and credits recipients.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
tradeAddress state variable is assigned in setTradeAddress.
owner is compared in the ensure() whitelist shortcut.
owner is the only guard on delegate().
owner is the only guard on init().
owner is the only guard on batchSend().
owner is the only guard on setTradeAddress().
canSale[_from] is read as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
tradeAddress is read as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
constant UNI router address is read as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
_minSale is compared against _value in condition().
_maxSale is compared against _value in condition().
_saleNum is compared against _onSaleNum[_from] in condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is read in condition() to enforce the per-account sale limit.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before moving funds.
ensure() requires condition() for non-whitelisted accounts.
delegate() performs an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to user-supplied code.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed without SafeMath (overflow/underflow risk in 0.5.x).
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value are unchecked arithmetic.
total = _value * _tos.length can silently overflow, breaking the balance invariant.
User-controlled _value is subtracted from the caller allowance without SafeMath.
User-controlled _value drives unchecked balance subtraction/addition.
User-controlled _value multiplies the caller-supplied array length without SafeMath.
constructor initializes totalSupply from the supply argument.
constructor mints the whole supply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI router] = uint(-1).

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only consumed by transfer() when it forwards to transferFrom().
_value is only consumed by transfer() when it forwards to transferFrom().
_from is the balance/allowance/whitelist subject of transferFrom().
_value is the amount checked and moved by transferFrom() and its unchecked arithmetic.
_spender only keys the allowance mapping written by approve().
_value is the approval amount stored by approve().
target address a is the destination of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
calldata b is the payload of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
_tos only drives the loop inside batchSend().
_value feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
addr is directly assigned to the tradeAddress state variable by setTradeAddress().
saleNum is directly stored into _saleNum by init().
token is directly scaled into _minSale by init().
maxToken is directly scaled into _maxSale by init().
